newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Foreigners pump $461.2 mln in Brazil bourse in Nov.
newsitem.headline: Foreigners pump $461.2 mln in Brazil bourse in Nov.

text.p: Net foreign capital inflows to Brazilian bourses under Annex Four rules totalled $461.1 million in November, up from $440.03 million in the previous month, Brazil's Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM) said. The Annex Four regulates investment in Brazilian shares, debentures and privatization bonds.
In a statement the CVM said November capital inflows totalled $2.130 billion against total outflows of $1.669 billion for the month.
So far this year, foreign capital inflows have amounted to $3.032 billion, CVM said.
